thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #44122 is blocked by a flaky db smoke test (integ-db-test/shard3). It passes locally for me. Can someone kick a rerun and eyeball?
mira: On it, kicking a rerun now. will report back.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Triggered build for PR #44122 — job: integ-db-test/shard3.
sam: Rerun finished — still failing: TestDBConnectionTimeout in setup. Stack shows timeout waiting for dockerized testdb.
joey: @alex any recent setup changes? Could be container ordering/race.
alex: I only changed kv-sharding logic, nothing touching tests. Pushing a quick 200ms sleep to setup just to rule out race, will trigger another rerun.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Build started for PR #44122 (job: integ-db-test/shard3).
ci-bot: ci-bot: Build finished — integ-db-test failed again (same TestDBConnectionTimeout).
mira: Can you paste the short stacktrace here? maybe it's a different flake.
alex: paste: ```Error: TimeoutError: DB connect timed out
  at tests/integration/db_test.go:123
  at testing.tRunner (testing.go:112)```
sam: That looks like the test is trying to connect before the DB ready-check completes. The fixture uses wait-for-it with a 3s timeout, might be too tight on CI.
joey: Try bumping wait-for-it to 10s and also increase wait loop interval. If that stabilizes we can remove the temporary sleep later.
alex: pushed change to bump wait-to 10s and adjusted order so container comes up before test runner. triggering rerun.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Build started for PR #44122 (job: integ-db-test/shard3).
ci-bot: ci-bot: Build passed — all integ-db-test shards green.
joey: Nice, thanks all. I'm good to approve.
mira: LGTM :thumbsup: will give final approve in GH and merge once quiet for a minute.
alex: thanks everyone — opening a follow-up issue to remove the added sleep and hunt the fixture flakiness properly.
